name: ccxt-mcp
description: The official CCXT MCP server plus the ccxt-mcp usage skill: connect your agent to 100+ crypto exchanges and prediction markets for market data, interactive charts, balances and opt-in trading, with API keys kept local.

exchange.title: Exchange (optional)
exchange.description: Exchange id, e.g. binance, kraken, okx. Leave blank for public market data only. For several exchanges or a wallet-based venue, use the config file below.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for the exchange above. Kept in secure storage on this machine, never shown to the model. Leave blank for market data only.

secret.title: API secret
secret.description: API secret for the exchange above. Kept in secure storage on this machine.

password.title: API passphrase (only OKX / KuCoin / Bitget)
password.description: API passphrase, needed only by some exchanges (OKX, KuCoin, Bitget). Leave blank otherwise. Kept in secure storage on this machine.

sandbox.title: Sandbox / testnet mode
sandbox.description: Use the exchange's testnet (fake money). Requires TESTNET API keys from the exchange's testnet portal.

enable_trading.title: Allow placing orders — sandbox/demo only
enable_trading.description: Enable order placement on sandbox/testnet or demo accounts only. Live trading and withdrawals must be enabled in the config file, not here.

config_file.title: Config file (several exchanges, wallet venues, or live trading)
config_file.description: Point this at a ccxt-mcp config.json with an "accounts" map to configure any number of exchanges, wallet-based venues (walletAddress/privateKey), or live trading/withdrawals. See https://docs.ccxt.com/docs/mcp. It merges with the exchange above; on a name clash the file wins.
